briefing.headline: OpenAI and Google race toward o4 and Gemini 3 launches as US tightens export controls on advanced chips

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AI frontier intensifies with multiple frontier model releases expected in August. US-China tensions over compute access escalate while safety concerns mount around multi-agent systems. Prompt injection attacks continue to dominate real-world deployments.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI prepares o4 for mid-August release featuring native multi-agent orchestration. Anthropic ships Claude 4 Opus with enhanced reasoning benchmarks. DeepSeek-V3 achieves parity with Western models on coding tasks at lower cost.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. New NIST guidelines emphasize runtime monitoring for agentic workflows.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: xAI breaks ground on Colossus 2 cluster with 1.2M H200 GPUs. TSMC reports record AI chip demand through Q3 2026. Microsoft expands Stargate supercluster to 200k Blackwell GPUs.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will the first model to reach 90% on GPQA Diamond trigger immediate export control escalation?
